en.askTitle: Enter your own income, costs and accountant fee to compare RESICO with the general regime and the ways of getting paid in dollars
en.runTitle: Puebla: a freelance translator billing US agencies, RESICO or the general regime

fields.label: Monthly income in USD
fields.value: About USD 3,200 a month now, expecting USD 4,500 in 2027

fields.label: Monthly deductible expenses in MXN
fields.placeholder: e.g. MXN 9,000 a month for a home-office share, software and equipment

en.template: Help me compare RESICO with the general regime as a freelance {profession} in {city}. I invoice {clients} in {currency} and expect about {income}, with {expenses} of deductible costs and a contador who charges {contador}. Rebuild the monthly ISR comparison, the deduction break-even and the take-home table with my numbers, check whether a month near the RESICO rate-band line changes the result, compare the ways of receiving dollars that I name, and list what to ask my contador, marking anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone, opening an account or submitting anything.

phases.title: Research the tax rules, the official exchange rate and the payment fees
phases.note: Tax-authority pages first, with the law text read on a mirror when the official site would not open
phases.judgment: When the official law site would not open, it read the law text on a mirror and labelled every figure from it as unconfirmed. It also found two rules that appear to disagree about the annual return and left that for the accountant to settle.

phases.title: Write the guide, with the VAT and invoicing sections and the take-home table
phases.note: Recommendation up front, then the regime comparison, fee comparison and take-home figures
phases.judgment: It corrected the pointer it had been given: the test for exported services sits in a different article than the request said. It also noted that translation is not on the statute’s list of exempt services, so whether the 0% rate applies is marked as an interpretation.

phases.title: Independent recalculation of every figure, plus desktop and phone layout
phases.note: Wording fixes made after the check
phases.judgment: The independent check recomputed every peso figure with no mismatches, and it flagged six places where a claim was stated too firmly or lacked a source label. All six were fixed in the page.

workers: Worked out how RESICO and the general regime tax her income, using the tax authority’s rate tables and the official exchange rate
Compared what Wise, Payoneer, PayPal and a direct bank transfer cost for receiving dollars
Checked how work for foreign clients is treated for VAT and how to issue an invoice to a US client
Independently recomputed every peso figure in the guide and checked its claims against the source list
